well: ODP Holes 201-1227A/D (Peru shelf, -427 m), 201-1228A/B/E (-262 m), 201-1229A/D (-152 m, the shallow brine site), 201-1230A/C (PERU TRENCH, -5,086 m) - PERU CONTINENTAL MARGIN, South Pacific (8.99-11.06 S, 77.96-80.58 W), the world's strongest upwelling system; ODP Leg 201 (2002) - THE FOUNDING EXPEDITION OF DEEP-BIOSPHERE SCIENCE, the first ocean drilling leg dedicated to subseafloor life; samples 0.86-248.17 mbsf; the catalogue's first SOUTH PACIFIC entries

fetch_method: read-only HTTPS fetch of the PANGAEA textfile export - COMPLETE dataset (876 data points per the header's own Size declaration, re-counted EXACT at gate time under the measured convention: 292 labels + 292 LODs + 107 rate values + 185 'below detection' comments, the rate and comment columns being perfectly COMPLEMENTARY so the count closes as exactly 3N) in one fetch

source_anomaly_disclosure: THREE structural quirks preserved verbatim and proven by counting: (1) 36 rows archive a detection limit of literal 0.00E000 pmol/cm3/day - a physically impossible zero LOD, a format-precision artifact carried as the archive wrote it; (2) the triplicate design breaks in exactly three places - one SINGLETON (1228A-10H-2 at 83.15 m, one aliquot where every other sample has three) and two split-depth groups where aliquots of one sample carry slightly different depths (1229A-5H-5 at 38.67/38.69/38.69 m and 1229D-7H-1 at 49.76/49.76/49.80 m) - intra-triplicate depth wobble preserved; (3) 1230C-2H-3 appears at TWO distinct depths (7.84 and 8.27 m) as two separate triplicates from one section
purpose: forty-sixth catalogue entry - the PERU MARGIN joins as region THIRTY-THREE (the catalogue's first South Pacific entries, shelf to 5-km trench, from the founding expedition of deep-biosphere science) and MICROBIAL ACTIVITY RATES are kind THIRTY-FIVE: the catalogue's first measurement of LIFE - not a proxy but metabolism itself, counted atom by radioactive atom - and the deep biosphere's structure is re-derived on every gate run: rates spanning SIX orders of magnitude that collapse with depth (185 of 292 results below detection - the negative results carried as first-class data), the sulfate-methane transition at 1227D burning 770x brighter (5,337 pmol/cm3/day at 6.76 m) than the layer two metres above it, and Site 1229's famous DOUBLE LIFE - detections at the seafloor, a quiet middle, then metabolism RE-IGNITING at 95-186 m where deep brine feeds sulfate back into the system from below
verified: 292 rows / 876 counted cells against the header's own Size declaration (EXACT as 3N via the proven SRR/comment complementarity); rate maximum 5,337.46 at 6.76 m and SMT spike ratio 770x pinned; 107/185 detection split pinned; 36 literal-zero LODs pinned; the singleton and both split-depth triplicates pinned; 1229 deep re-ignition pinned (detections > 0.1 at 95.14, 157.80 and 185.82 m after none between 31 and 95 m); gate-pinned; source URL serves the identical dataset
